Record detailed Bluetooth and sensor data. Turn off after troubleshooting.
Set up the sensor and the transmitter in the official Eversense app first. AAPS does not do the first setup.
Then force stop the official app: Android settings, Apps, Eversense, Force stop. Only one app can be connected to the transmitter at a time.
Keep the phone near the transmitter, with Bluetooth on.
AAPS signs in with your Eversense account: a 365 needs it to connect, and the cloud upload uses it. The login is not exported with the settings.

A 365 registers with Eversense online the first time. This can take a minute.

Cannot connect. Eversense must be the active BG source, and Bluetooth must be on.
Leave the pairing? What is done so far stays.
